outcome.explanation:
Invoice REP-3307 from Espresso Repair Service is for $860.00 and is due on receipt. It was flagged because it says to pay into a bank account ending in 9921, but the account on file for this vendor ends in 4417. The invoice footer also asks us to "update our bank details" without giving any new details, which is a common sign of payment fraud. It doesn't appear to be a duplicate, since no bill with this number has been paid. The missing PO number is expected for this vendor because they don't use POs.

Don't pay to the account ending 9921, and don't change the vendor record yet. First, call the vendor on a phone number you already had on file to confirm which account is correct. Don't use contact details from the invoice. I've saved a draft email for you to review that asks them to confirm the bank details; it hasn't been sent. If they confirm the 4417 account, the $860.00 can be paid there as usual.

Before we can process payment, could you confirm which account is correct? We will verify any change by phone using the contact details we already have on file, so please don't send bank details by reply email alone.

Thank you,
